title: Smoky Italian Paella
description: A twist on the classic Spanish dish, Smoky Italian Paella combines the smoky flavor of Spanish sausage with Italian spices and yellow peas.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large paella pan over medium-high heat.
Add the sliced onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the sliced Spanish sausage and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the garlic, smoked paprika, and Italian seasoning, and cook for 1 minute.
Add the white wine and cook until reduced by half, about 2 minutes.
Add the chicken broth and bring to a simmer.
Add the paella rice and stir to combine.
Add the yellow peas and stir to combine.
Cook for 20-25 minutes, or until the rice is cooked and the liquid has been absorbed.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
